beats: A week into school, my three kids were still on last year's grade — I'd forgotten to bump them.
That one number decides their lessons — forget it, and a year goes to the wrong content.
It's like forgetting to set the clocks forward — everything keeps running on old time.
Now a nightly cron checks the date and bumps every child's grade automatically.
All three boys jumped a grade the same day it shipped — next year needs zero manual steps.
